'''Rinfro''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Rinfro was once locked into a pair of [[Stuncuffs/Legends|stun cuffs]], and found the pain was excruciating.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
